tuning_key.text: At least forgiveness can give us some pause / Before we give up on what it's all about
tuning_key.attribution: Chords of Truth — Lucid Principles Canon (CC BY 4.0)

context_block: Something remains unfinished in the space between us, held open by a breath that arrives before the closing. In this pause, the door stays unlatched long enough to remember what we almost walked away from.

practice.title: Locate the Threshold
practice.instruction: Bring attention to the sensation of contact between body and ground, waiting for the breath that arrives before the next motion.

practice.title: Soften the Latch
practice.instruction: Release the tension at the center of the chest by a single degree, maintaining an opening for what has not yet passed.

practice.title: Activate the Echo
practice.instruction: Press play on the audio and let the sound occupy the space that has been kept unlatched.
